title: Colimit comparison for descended scalar section groups
statement: In the setting of lem-weil-pbc-etale-limit-scalar-section-zero-eventually, suppose the displayed section maps rho and mu satisfy their identity, composition and cocone laws. Construct the functor A:J -> AddCommGrpCat with A_j=F_j(Tj) and A(a)=rho_a and the cocone C with point L.pt(Tlim) and legs mu_j. Then C satisfies the colimit universal property. This statement concerns that universal property only; it asserts no eventual vanishing criterion. All data are constructed from the given section maps, and only the proof of the universal property is postponed. The notions are those of def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-pbc-category-colimit, def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves, def-pc-fibre-product.

source.place: Sites Tag 09YN, lemma-colimit; Etale Cohomology Tag 09YQ, affine-site realization; Cohomology on Sites Tag 09YP, degree zero.

proof.text: The upper tail J is nonempty and directed. Construct A and C from the given coherence proofs. The forgetful functor from abelian groups to types preserves filtered colimits (including the smaller index universe) and reflects this colimit. Apply Types.FilteredColimit.isColimitOf' to its image cocone.
For each limit section use etale_limit_scalar_sections_representatives to choose a stage section mapping to it; reverse the equality to match the Type-colimit surjectivity criterion.

For two sections at the same stage with equal limit images, use etale_limit_scalar_sections_eventual_equality to obtain a later arrow equalizing them. This is precisely the remaining Type-colimit criterion; reflect the resulting colimit back to abelian groups.

proof_origin.place: Sites Tag 09YN and Etale Cohomology Tag 09YQ, separated into representatives and eventual equality; Mathlib Types.FilteredColimit.isColimitOf' and isColimitOfReflects. Formal reduction by H4.

mathlib_searches.query: Inverse image adjunction units and pullback composition give functorial transition maps on sections of varying etale sheaves
A section of a compatible system of etale abelian sheaves on an inverse limit is zero if and only if it becomes zero at a later stage
mathlib_searches.results: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_appTop_map_eq_zero_of_isLimit and exists_app_map_eq_zero_of_isLimit concern structure sheaves, not arbitrary etale abelian sheaves. No matching geometric comparison.

SectionContinuity gives a fixed-base sheaf result; ColimitSites and ColimitSiteAbelianSectionUniversality give fixed-sheaf inverse-image presentations. Coherence has upperStarId_hom_app_unit_app and upperStarComp_hom_app_unit_app, but no laws for this varying sheaf system.

from.place: Step 3 of the acyclic-replacement plan, scalar continuity used in the finite Cech-complex comparison of 09YP.

theorem etale_limit_scalar_section_colimit
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c)
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, CompactSpace (D.obj i)] [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ (i j : Iᵒᵖ) (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f)]
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hidentity : ∀ i : I, φ (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (F i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj (op i))).hom.app (F i))
    (hcomposition : ∀ (i j k : I) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k),
      φ (f ≫ g) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op) (D.map f.op)
          (D.map (f ≫ g).op) (D.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op)).map (φ f) ≫ φ g)
    (G : I ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eG : ∀ i : I, G.obj i ≅
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).obj (F i))
    (hG : ∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), G.map f =
      (eG i).hom ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j)) (D.map f.op)
          (c.π.app (op i)) (c.w f.op).symm).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j))).map (φ f) ≫ (eG j).inv)
    (L : Cocone G) (hL : IsColimit L)
    (i₀ : I) (T₀ : (D.obj (op i₀)).Etale)
    [CompactSpace T₀.left] [QuasiSeparatedSpace T₀.left] :
    let J := {j : I // i₀ ≤ j}
    let Tj := fun j : J ↦
      (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤
        (D.map (homOfLE j.property).op)).obj T₀
    let Tlim := (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (c.π.app (op i₀))).obj T₀
    ∀ (γ : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),
        (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤
          (D.map (show j.val ⟶ k.val from a).op)).obj (Tj j) ≅ Tj k)
      (δ : ∀ j : J,
        (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (c.π.app (op j.val))).obj (Tj j) ≅ Tlim),
      (∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),
        (γ j k a).hom.left ≫ pullback.fst T₀.hom (D.map (homOfLE k.property).op) =
          pullback.fst (Tj j).hom (D.map (show j.val ⟶ k.val from a).op) ≫
            pullback.fst T₀.hom (D.map (homOfLE j.property).op)) →
      (∀ j : J,
        (δ j).hom.left ≫ pullback.fst T₀.hom (c.π.app (op i₀)) =
          pullback.fst (Tj j).hom (c.π.app (op j.val)) ≫
            pullback.fst T₀.hom (D.map (homOfLE j.property).op)) →
    let ρ := fun (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) ↦
      ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (D.map (show j.val ⟶ k.val from a).op)).unit.app (F j.val)).hom.app (op (Tj j)) ≫
        (φ (show j.val ⟶ k.val from a)).hom.app
          (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤
            (D.map (show j.val ⟶ k.val from a).op)).obj (Tj j))) ≫
        (F k.val).obj.map (γ j k a).inv.op
    let μ := fun j : J ↦
      ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (c.π.app (op j.val))).unit.app (F j.val)).hom.app (op (Tj j)) ≫
        (eG j.val).inv.hom.app
          (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤
            (c.π.app (op j.val))).obj (Tj j))) ≫
        (L.ι.app j.val).hom.app
          (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤
            (c.π.app (op j.val))).obj (Tj j))) ≫
        L.pt.obj.map (δ j).inv.op
    ∀ (hid : ∀ j : J, ρ j j (𝟙 j) = 𝟙 _)
      (hcomp : ∀ (j k l : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (b : k ⟶ l),
        ρ j l (a ≫ b) = ρ j k a ≫ ρ k l b)
      (hleg : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k), ρ j k a ≫ μ k = μ j),
    let A : J ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} :=
      { obj := fun j ↦ (F j.val).obj.obj (op (Tj j))
        map := fun a ↦ ρ _ _ a
        map_id := hid
        map_comp := hcomp _ _ _ }
    let C : Cocone A :=
      { pt := L.pt.obj.obj (op Tlim)
        ι := { app := μ
               naturality := fun j k a ↦ by simpa using hleg j k a } }
    Nonempty (IsColimit C)
